---
name: Good First Issue
about: A bounded task with reproducible behavior and a verification path
title: "[Good First Issue] "
labels: good-first-issue
assignees: ''
---

## Task and observable problem
Describe one reproducible problem, current build/route, and why the change is useful.

## Discipline and scope
State the relevant skills and a bounded deliverable. Do not presume ability or availability from employment or veteran status.

## Relevant files and existing guidance
List exact files and link the contribution/setup instructions. Identify the implementation lane; root presentation, precinct proposal and historical prototype are distinct.

## Reproduce and expected behavior
1. Starting state and public-safe steps:
2. Observed result:
3. Expected result:

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One measurable result:
- [ ] Existing behavior that must remain unchanged:

## Verification
Give the exact command or browser sequence and expected observable result. Identify dependencies and required access; do not request production credentials or Discord participation.

## Non-goals and boundaries
State excluded features and privacy, rights, accessibility and canon constraints. Use synthetic data; keep secrets and private records out of the issue.

## Reviewer and clarification
Name the reviewer only after they agree, or identify this issue as the public clarification/escalation route pending maintainer confirmation. A contributor may ask a partial question without supplying a complete patch.

## Availability and handoff
Before presenting this as ready, confirm it is unassigned, not already covered by a PR, reproducible with documented access, and small enough to review. Comment before starting; no assignment is automatic. If stopping, leave build, findings, blockers and next action here. No ongoing production obligation or future pay is implied.
